segments.name: Semiconductors and modules
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets high-performance RF, microwave, millimeter wave, optical and photonic semiconductor products for industrial, defense, data center and telecommunications customers.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable operating segment that designs, develops, manufactures and markets semiconductors and modules.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase semiconductor products and components incorporated into larger electronic systems; revenue derived from direct sales, independent sales representatives and distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is derived from sales of high-performance RF, microwave, millimeter wave, optical and photonic semiconductor products. We design, integrate, manufacture and package differentiated, semiconductor-based products that we sell to customers through our direct sales organization, our network of independent sales representatives and our distributors.
